title: Introduction to Front-End Development
description:
Meta Front-End Developer: Introduction Certificate
A professional credential from Meta validating a solid foundation in front-end web development. It demonstrates a clear understanding of the distinct roles of Front-End, Back-End, and Full-Stack developers. The certification covers practical expertise in building and styling responsive webpages using HTML & CSS, alongside mastering the strategic benefits and implementation of modern UI frameworks to optimize development workflows and elevate user experiences.

title: Introduction to Software Engineering
description: A professional credential from IBM validating core software engineering principles and the complete SDLC. It covers advanced system architecture, design patterns, and UML documentation, alongside practical full-stack application development and computer programming constructs using Python.

title: Programming with JavaScript
description: Comprehensive credential focusing on advanced JavaScript programming, data structures, and object manipulation. It covers functional and event-driven design concepts, JSON management, and modern backend integration with Node.js, while emphasizing code reliability through robust unit testing using the Jest framework.

title: Data entry in Microsoft Excel
description: Professional foundational credential focused on data management and workspace productivity. It validates hands-on expertise in structured data entry, advanced utilization of spreadsheet software for data analysis and reporting, and core proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite to streamline administrative workflows.

title: Version Control
description: Technical credential validating mastery of modern Version Control Systems (VCS) and collaborative workflows. It covers terminal navigation using Linux/Unix command-line interfaces, managing code revisions, and hosting repositories on GitHub to implement structured branch management and seamless team collaboration.
